title: Behavioral Health Administrative & Provider Support Coordinator – Part-Time
description:
We are a U.S.-based social-services organization seeking an experienced Behavioral Health Administrative & Provider Support Coordinator to provide remote administrative and operational support to our management team and field providers.



This is not a clinical position and not a general VA position. We need someone who understands behavioral-health or healthcare operations and can independently manage routine administrative matters, keep providers organized, identify missing information, follow up consistently, and know when an issue needs to be escalated to management.



Responsibilities include:



* Coordinate provider/Behavioral Aide schedules and coverage

* Respond to routine provider questions and follow up on outstanding needs

* Review service notes/documentation for completeness and required information

* Track missing or late documentation and follow up

* Maintain appointment, deadline, i
 and administrative trackers

* Assist with provider onboarding, orientation and training coordination

* Help coordinate administrative response during i
 or unexpected situations

* Maintain organized records and communications

* Follow confidentiality/HIPAA requirements

* Provide management with concise updates on unresolved or urgent matters

* Help improve administrative processes, checklists and workflows

* Support recruiting/screening/onboarding when needed



Required Experience:



We strongly prefer candidates with direct experience in behavioral health, mental health, healthcare administration, social services, medical administration, provider coordination or a closely related field.



You must be organized, professional, dependable, comfortable communicating with providers, able to follow up without being reminded, and understand the difference between an administrative decision and a matter that requires clinical or management escalation.



Schedule:

Approximately 5–10 hours per week initially, with additional hours available as services increase and based on performance.



Some availability overlapping U.S. Eastern Time is required.



To Apply:



Please answer these 5 questions:



1. Describe your direct behavioral-health, mental-health, healthcare or social-services experience.

2. Have you reviewed provider/service documentation for completeness or compliance? Explain briefly.

3. Have you coordinated schedules or handled last-minute provider coverage?

4. What hours can you consistently work overlapping U.S. Eastern Time?

5. What is your requested hourly rate and earliest available start date?

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor — Peakfinity Labs



**Employment Type:** [Full-Time / Part-Time / Contract]

**Department:** Marketing & Content



## About Peakfinity Labs



Peakfinity Labs is a manufacturing company focused on supplements and cosmetics. We're looking for a talented Video Editor to help us tell our story — from the factory floor to the finished product — through compelling, high-quality video content.



## About the Role



We're hiring a Video Editor to create engaging video content that showcases our manufacturing processes, products, and company culture. You'll work with raw footage from our facilities and turn it into polished videos for marketing, training, social media, and internal communications.



## What You'll Do



- Edit raw footage into polished, engaging videos for marketing, social media, and internal use

- Cut manufacturing/process footage into clear, compelling narratives

- Add motion graphics, text overlays, color correction, and sound design as needed

- Collaborate with the marketing team on video concepts and messaging

- Manage multiple projects and turnaround deadlines

- Organize and maintain video assets and project files



## What We're Looking For



- Proven experience editing video content (portfolio required — see below)

- Proficiency in editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro

- Strong storytelling instincts — ability to turn raw, unscripted footage into a clear narrative

- Understanding of pacing, color grading, sound design, and motion graphics

- Comfortable working with industrial/manufacturing footage (a plus, not required)

- Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines



## How to Apply



To apply, please send us:



1. **Your portfolio** — a link or reel showcasing your best editing work.

2. **(Optional, but recommended) A sample edit** — To help us prioritize applications, we invite you to download raw footage from **
** and produce a short edited video (60–90 seconds) that tells a clear, engaging story using the clips provided. We want to see how you structure a narrative, pace cuts, and polish raw material — not just your software skills.



 *Tips for a strong sample edit:*

 - Choose a clear focus or theme rather than using every clip

 - Aim for a logical flow: an opening hook, a clear middle, and a satisfying close

 - Include basic color correction, clean audio, and simple titles/graphics if relevant

 - Keep it tight — quality of storytelling matters more than length



Applicants who submit a sample edit alongside their portfolio will be prioritized for review.

---



Peakfinity Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Candidates with direct bar/liquor inventory-control experience will receive strong consideration.



Experience only as a general VA, social-media manager or customer-service representative is not sufficient.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Position Overview:

We're looking for a strong, self-directed Accounting Manager to own the full financial operations of two service companies under one parent LLC. This is not a data-entry role. You will be responsible for keeping the books accurate every day, making sure payroll and payroll taxes are handled correctly, tracking our debt obligations, and giving the Owner a clear picture of profitability and cash flow. The right person spots problems before they become problems and works without being told what to do next. This role reports directly to the Owner.



Key Responsibilities:



Daily Bookkeeping & Reconciliation



Reconcile all bank and credit card accounts daily using QuickBooks bank feeds, and categorize transactions accurately.

Investigate and resolve discrepancies the same day they appear.

Maintain clean, separate books for two entities.



Payroll & Payroll Taxes



Process weekly/bi-weekly payroll accurately and on schedule.

Calculate, file, and pay US payroll taxes on time, including federal withholding, FICA, FUTA (Form 940), quarterly Form 941, NC state withholding, and NC unemployment.

Maintain payroll tax deposit schedules and make sure there are zero late filings or penalties.



Job Profitability



Track and report profitability by job, service type, and client for both residential and commercial services.

Analyze labor, supply, and overhead costs against job revenue, and flag underperforming jobs or pricing issues to the Owner.



Cash Flow Forecasting



Build and maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast.

Project upcoming obligations (payroll, taxes, loan remittances, vendor bills) and alert the Owner to potential shortfalls in advance.



Debt & Financing Management



Properly record and track merchant cash advances (MCAs) and Stripe Capital loans, including the original balance, fees/factor rates, and daily or weekly remittances.

Reconcile loan balances to lender statements and maintain an accurate payoff schedule for every financing obligation.



AP, AR & Reporting



Manage accounts receivable, monitor due dates, and follow up on outstanding invoices.

Process accounts payable on time or ahead of schedule, and maintain an organized vendor and approval system.

Complete month-end close and deliver monthly financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) with a written summary for the Owner.

Assist with budgeting and expense management.

Coordinate with our CPA for quarterly and annual filings.



Qualifications:



5+ years of experience in accounting or bookkeeping, including managing books independently.

Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks, including bank feeds, rules, classes, and reporting.

Proven working knowledge of US federal and state payroll tax calculation, filing, and deposits.

Experience tracking business loans and financing, with MCA and/or Stripe Capital experience strongly preferred.

Experience building cash flow forecasts and job-costing or profitability reports.

Ability to work independently, manage your own deadlines, and bring solutions rather than questions.

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

High integrity with confidential financial information.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred.



Preferred Skills:



Experience in service-based businesses, especially cleaning, home services, or field service.

Multi-entity bookkeeping experience.

Familiarity with Profit First.

Experience working on an EOS team (Scorecards, Rocks).

title: Client Case & Business Operations Coordinator
description:
ABOUT VLARI



VLARI is a specialized U.S.-based advisory firm serving established business owners. We work with a limited number of clients and prioritize quality, accuracy, confidentiality, and thoughtful service over high case volume.



We are seeking a reliable, highly organized Client Case & Business Operations Coordinator for a full-time, long-term position.



This is a versatile role for someone who enjoys managing detailed processes, communicating professionally with clients, organizing financial documents, and ensuring that every case continues moving forward.



This is not a sales, call-center, or independent advisory position. You will receive training in our internal processes. You will begin with client onboarding, administrative support, document organization, and case coordination. As you demonstrate proficiency, your responsibilities may expand into preliminary case preparation and implementation tracking.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



Once a client completes payment, you will become the client’s primary operational contact.



You will own the administrative journey from payment through completed onboarding and preparation of a review-ready client file.



You will make sure clients understand what is required, submit the appropriate documents, answer all required intake questions, receive timely updates, and progress through each stage of the engagement.



POST-PAYMENT CLIENT ONBOARDING



Your responsibilities will include:



* Sending welcome communications immediately after payment

* Explaining the onboarding process and next steps

* Providing access to the secure client portal

* Confirming completion of engagement documents and required acknowledgments

* Scheduling onboarding, review, and presentation meetings

* Guiding clients through intake questionnaires

* Asking approved follow-up questions when information is incomplete

* Providing and explaining the required-document checklist

* Collecting tax returns, financial statements, payroll records, entity documents, insurance information, investment statements, and other requested records

* Reviewing documents for completeness, legibility, correct reporting periods, and missing pages

* Comparing submitted documents against the client’s checklist

* Following up professionally for missing information

* Documenting the client’s objectives, concerns, priorities, and unanswered questions

* Entering and verifying information in company systems

* Maintaining accurate notes, tasks, deadlines, and pipeline stages

* Preparing a consolidated internal case summary

* Identifying inconsistencies and questions that require escalation

* Confirming when the client’s file is complete and ready for professional review

* Sending appropriate progress updates throughout the engagement

* Coordinating communication among the client, company leadership, and assigned professionals



CASE AND IMPLEMENTATION COORDINATION



After training, your responsibilities may also include:



* Organizing financial and business information for internal analysis

* Extracting designated information from financial statements and tax documents

* Preparing preliminary internal summaries for review

* Operating internal assessment and case-preparation systems

* Coordinating reviews with accountants, attorneys, insurance professionals, and other specialists

* Recording professional feedback and requested changes

* Preparing meeting briefs and client presentation materials

* Creating and maintaining implementation checklists

* Assigning and tracking approved implementation steps

* Following up with clients and outside professionals

* Assisting with insurance and annuity application processing

* Tracking applications, signatures, transfers, funding, and outstanding requirements

* Communicating with insurance carriers and related organizations

* Maintaining accurate case statuses until completion

* Escalating matters requiring professional judgment or approval



ADMINISTRATIVE AND BUSINESS OPERATIONS



Because VLARI serves a limited number of quality clients, this position will support several areas of the business. Additional responsibilities may include:



* Managing calendars and appointment confirmations

* Monitoring and organizing company email

* Answering and routing administrative client calls

* Drafting routine client communications

* Updating CRM records and pipeline stages

* Organizing company files and folders

* Maintaining standard operating procedures

* Auditing client files for missing information

* Assisting with basic bookkeeping and operational reporting

* Maintaining service and follow-up calendars

* Researching administrative information when assigned

* Testing intake forms, reports, and internal workflows

* Supporting special company projects during lower-volume periods



PROFESSIONAL BOUNDARIES



You will explain company processes, collect factual information, answer approved administrative questions, and coordinate work that has already been authorized.



You will not be expected or authorized to independently:



* Provide U.S. tax advice

* Provide legal advice

* Recommend investments, insurance policies, or annuities

* Approve client strategies

* Promise financial or tax results

* Represent yourself as a U.S.-licensed professional

* Release a final client design without approval



Any question involving professional judgment or a recommendation must be documented and escalated to the appropriate professional.



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have an accounting, bookkeeping, business administration, insurance, or financial-services background

* Have experience supporting U.S. clients or companies

* Are comfortable reviewing financial documents

* Communicate clearly and professionally by email, telephone, and video

* Are highly organized and careful with details

* Follow instructions and documented procedures

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Are comfortable performing both analytical and routine administrative work

* Know when to ask questions or escalate an issue

* Enjoy managing cases from beginning to completion

* Want a stable, long-term role with one company

* Respect confidentiality and sensitive client information

* Prefer quality and accuracy over high-volume, rushed work

* Are interested in growing within an organization rather than building a competing advisory practice



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Strong spoken and written English

* At least two years of relevant administrative, bookkeeping, accounting, insurance, client-service, or case-management experience

* Strong spreadsheet, email, and document-management skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Leadership Skills

* Managerial Skills

* Professional telephone presence

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet

* Quiet and professional environment for client calls

* Ability to handle confidential financial information

* Ability to organize multiple cases and deadlines

* Willingness to complete reference and background checks

* Willingness to sign confidentiality, data-security, and intellectual-property agreements

* Availability for scheduled overlap with U.S. Pacific Time



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:



* QuickBooks Online

* GoHighLevel or another CRM

* U.S. bookkeeping or accounting

* U.S. business financial statements

* U.S. business tax documents

* Client onboarding

* Life-insurance or annuity case processing

* Financial-advisor support

* Tax Strategies

* Project Manager

* Project Coordinator

* DocuSign or secure client portals

* Workflow and implementation tracking

* Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets



COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE



* 20-40 hours per week

* Initial 90-day evaluation period

* Compensation and responsibility review following successful completion of the evaluation period

* Long-term growth opportunity based on performance, accuracy, reliability, and judgment



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that do not follow all instructions will not be considered.



Please submit:



1. Your current résumé.

2. A link to a two-to-three-minute video introduction.

3. Complete written responses to the questions below.

4. The words “VLARI Case Coordinator” as the first line of your application.



Your video may be submitted using Loom, Google Drive, an unlisted YouTube video, or another accessible video-link service. Confirm that anyone with the link can view it.



IN YOUR VIDEO, PLEASE ADDRESS:



* Your name and current location

* Your most relevant professional experience

* The types of U.S. clients or companies you have supported

* Your experience with accounting, bookkeeping, client onboarding, insurance, or case management

* Why you are comfortable performing both administrative and analytical work

* How you communicate with a client who has not submitted required information

* Why you are interested in a long-term position



Please speak naturally. Do not simply read your résumé. Video-production quality is not important. We are evaluating your communication, professionalism, thought process, and ability to interact comfortably with clients.



WRITTEN APPLICATION QUESTIONS



1. Describe a situation in which you discovered missing or inaccurate information in a client file. What did you do?



2. How do you organize multiple clients, tasks, and deadlines?



3. What accounting, bookkeeping, CRM, project-management, and document-management systems have you used?



4. Describe your experience collecting information or documents from clients.



5. Are you comfortable making and receiving professional client calls? Please describe your experience.



6. How would you follow up with a client who has not responded to two document requests?



7. What would you do if a client asked you a technical question that you were not trained or authorized to answer?



8. Are you comfortable performing scheduling, email follow-up, data entry, file organization, and other administrative tasks while learning more advanced responsibilities?



9. Are you currently working for other clients? If so, describe your current schedule and availability.



10. What monthly compensation are you seeking?



11. Please provide two professional references.



SELECTION PROCESS



Qualified applicants may be invited to:



* Attend a video interview

* Complete a short paid assessment using fictional client information

* Draft a sample client email

* Review a sample file for missing information

* Prepare a brief internal case summary

* Participate in a mock client call

title: AI Content & Social Media Marketing Coordinator
description:
ABOUT VLARI



VLARI is a specialized U.S.-based advisory firm serving established business owners. Our content focuses on business structure, tax efficiency, cash flow, retained capital, and long-term wealth objectives.



We are seeking a full-time AI Content & Social Media Marketing Coordinator to manage the production, repurposing, scheduling, distribution, and performance tracking of our content.



This is a long-term execution and coordination position. You will receive approved messaging, scripts, brand standards, and strategic direction. Your responsibility will be to turn those ideas into professional content and distribute that content consistently across our marketing channels.



PLATFORMS



You will help manage content and marketing across:



* YouTube

* Instagram

*

* TikTok

* LinkedIn

* Email marketing



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Your responsibilities will include:



* Maintaining a detailed content calendar

* Producing content from approved scripts and recorded material

* Creating videos using approved AI presenter, avatar, image, and voice tools

* Editing short-form and long-form video content

* Repurposing one core piece of content across multiple platforms

* Writing and adapting captions, titles, descriptions, and calls to action

* Creating or coordinating thumbnails, graphics, carousels, and supporting visual assets

* Scheduling and publishing approved content

* Verifying that scheduled content publishes correctly

* Checking spelling, captions, links, tags, thumbnails, and formatting

* Organizing scripts, source files, drafts, approved content, and published assets

* Monitoring comments, messages, and meaningful engagement

* Using approved responses for general questions

* Routing qualified inquiries into the appropriate company process

* Supporting direct-message campaigns and lead-generation workflows

* Preparing email campaigns and automated nurture sequences

* Tracking which content produces leads, diagnostic completions, appointments, and clients

* Preparing clear weekly marketing-performance reports

* Supporting other marketing and content projects as assigned



AI PRESENTER AND VIDEO PRODUCTION



VLARI uses approved AI presenter, voice, image, and video-production tools to produce content featuring the company’s founder.



After training, you may be responsible for:



* Creating videos using the founder’s approved digital twin or AI presenter

* Using only authorized image, voice, avatar, and brand assets

* Following approved scripts and production instructions

* Identifying and correcting robotic speech, unnatural pacing, pronunciation errors, and visual inconsistencies

* Maintaining consistency in the presenter’s identity, appearance, clothing, hair, jewelry, background, and overall presentation

* Adding approved captions, music, supporting footage, graphics, and transitions

* Producing horizontal and vertical video formats

* Preparing short-form clips from longer videos

* Maintaining organized records of every draft, revision, and approved version

* Obtaining approval before publishing content featuring the founder’s image, likeness, or voice



Experience with every tool is not required, but you must be comfortable learning new AI systems.



Tools may include:



* HeyGen

* Higgsfield

* Seedance

* CapCut

* Canva

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Other AI video and content-production platforms



CONTENT REPURPOSING



You must be able to take one approved core message and develop multiple pieces of content from it.



For example, one five-minute educational video may become:



* One full YouTube video

* Multiple YouTube Shorts

* Multiple Instagram Reels

* Multiple TikTok videos

*
 video content

* LinkedIn video posts

* Written LinkedIn posts

* Educational carousels

* Story content

* One or more email campaigns



You will adapt each piece for the platform while preserving the founder’s message, voice, and professional positioning.



LINKEDIN RESPONSIBILITIES



LinkedIn is a priority platform for both the founder’s personal brand and the VLARI company page.



Your responsibilities may include:



* Managing approved content for the founder’s personal LinkedIn profile

* Managing approved content for the VLARI company page

* Turning videos into authoritative written LinkedIn posts

* Creating LinkedIn educational documents, carousels, and case-based content

* Maintaining profile and Featured-section content

* Monitoring comments, messages, and high-value engagement

* Drafting responses using approved language and the founder’s voice

* Identifying potential business-owner and professional connections

* Supporting approved LinkedIn Sales Navigator searches

* Organizing lead lists

* Supporting approved connection and follow-up workflows

* Routing qualified LinkedIn conversations into GoHighLevel

* Tracking connection acceptance, replies, diagnostic completions, appointments, and conversions

* Coordinating with a LinkedIn specialist when advanced campaign setup is required



You may not send unapproved mass messages, use unauthorized automation, change outreach positioning, or communicate as the founder without authorization.


 MARKETING



Your responsibilities will include:



* Turning approved videos and content into email campaigns

* Writing and formatting email drafts using approved messaging

* Scheduling approved broadcast emails

* Loading automated email sequences

* Segmenting contacts using established criteria

* Testing subject lines and calls to action

* Checking links, spelling, formatting, and mobile appearance

* Monitoring delivery, opens, clicks, replies, and conversions

* Maintaining email tags and contact lists

* Supporting lead-nurture and client-education campaigns

* Identifying emails that generate diagnostic completions, appointments, or purchases

* Maintaining active unsubscribe and compliance functions



SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT



You will help manage the daily execution of VLARI’s social-media presence.



Responsibilities may include:



* Scheduling and publishing approved content

* Monitoring comments and direct messages

* Responding to basic questions using approved responses

* Escalating client-specific or technical questions

* Maintaining consistent branding across all accounts

* Checking profile links and calls to action

* Supporting ManyChat and GoHighLevel workflows

* Maintaining accurate campaign and lead-source information

* Identifying outdated content, links, offers, or profile information

* Monitoring trends relevant to the company’s audience

* Recommending ways to adapt relevant trends without weakening the brand

* Identifying high-performing content that should be reused or expanded



MARKETING ANALYTICS



You will track business results, not only likes and followers.



Relevant measurements may include:



* Reach and views

* Watch time

* Audience retention

* Saves and shares

* Comments and direct messages

* Link clicks

* Email opens and clicks

* Diagnostic starts

* Diagnostic completions

* Qualified leads

* Appointment requests

* Purchases

* Client conversions

* Revenue connected to specific content or campaigns



You will prepare a simple weekly report showing:



* What was published

* What performed best

* What generated qualified engagement

* What produced leads or conversions

* What should be tested next

* What requires management attention



PAID ADVERTISING SUPPORT



This position may support paid advertising by:



* Organizing approved advertising assets

* Uploading approved creative and copy

* Maintaining campaign naming and tracking standards

* Monitoring whether advertisements, links, and forms are functioning

* Coordinating with an outside advertising specialist or agency

* Preparing basic performance reports

* Identifying successful organic content that may be suitable for advertising

* Tracking leads from advertisement through conversion



You will not independently change advertising budgets, targeting, offers, or major campaign strategy unless specifically authorized.



BRAND AND COMPLIANCE STANDARDS



VLARI serves an established and sophisticated audience. All content must be professional, credible, polished, and consistent.



You must:



* Follow approved messaging and terminology

* Maintain the company’s established visual identity

* Use only approved colors, fonts, logos, images, and presenter assets

* Proofread and review all content before submitting it for approval

* Verify names, dates, figures, links, and claims

* Use approved disclosures when required

* Protect client confidentiality

* Protect company intellectual property

* Maintain organized records of approvals and published content



You may not independently:



* Promise tax savings or financial results

* Publish unverified financial figures

* Provide tax, legal, investment, or insurance advice

* Respond to individualized strategy questions

* Recommend insurance or financial products

* Use actual client information without written authorization

* Create fictional testimonials

* Remove or alter approved disclosures

* Publish content using the founder’s image, voice, or AI presenter without authorization

* Change company pricing, offers, positioning, or strategy

* Share internal scripts, systems, credentials, or intellectual property



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have experience managing social media for a U.S.-based company or professional brand

* Understand both short-form and long-form content

* Can edit videos and create professional visual assets

* Have email-marketing experience

* Are comfortable using AI content-production tools

* Can follow detailed brand and messaging guidelines

* Have excellent written and spoken English

* Understand that marketing should generate measurable business activity

* Can manage multiple platforms and deadlines

* Are highly organized

* Pay close attention to visual and written details

* Can work independently without publishing unauthorized material

* Accept feedback professionally and make accurate revisions

* Are comfortable performing routine execution work such as uploading, scheduling, file naming, caption formatting, and checking links

* Want a stable, long-term position with one company



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* At least two years of experience in social media, content production, video editing, or digital marketing

* Strong written and spoken English

* Video-editing experience

* Experience managing at least three major social platforms

* Experience creating or formatting email campaigns

* Strong content-organization and file-management skills

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet

* Ability to meet deadlines consistently

* Ability to follow approval procedures

* Availability for scheduled overlap with U.S. Pacific Time

* Willingness to sign confidentiality, data-security, intellectual-property, voice, image, and AI-asset agreements



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



* Founder-led personal brands

* Professional-services marketing

* LinkedIn personal-brand management

* LinkedIn company-page management

* LinkedIn Sales Navigator

* YouTube Studio

* Instagram

*

* TikTok

* Meta Business Suite

* HeyGen

* Higgsfield

* Seedance

* CapCut

* Canva

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* GoHighLevel

* ManyChat

* Email automation

* Content analytics

* Lead-generation funnels



COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE





* 10-40 hours per week

* Initial 90-day evaluation period

* Compensation and responsibility review after successful completion of the evaluation period

* Long-term growth opportunity based on quality, accuracy, reliability, initiative, and measurable results



HOW TO APPLY



APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please submit:



1. Your current résumé.

2. A link to a two-to-three-minute video introduction.

3. A portfolio containing at least three relevant examples.

4. Complete written responses to the application questions below.

5. The words “VLARI Content Coordinator” as the first line of your application.



Your video may be submitted using Loom, Google Drive, an unlisted YouTube video, or another accessible video-link service. Confirm that anyone with the link can view it.



VIDEO APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



Your video must address:



* Your name and current location

* Your most relevant social-media and marketing experience

* The platforms you have personally managed

* Your experience with LinkedIn

* Your video-editing experience

* Your experience with AI content tools

* Your email-marketing experience

* How you would turn one core video into content for multiple platforms

* Why you are interested in a long-term position with VLARI



Please speak naturally and do not simply read your résumé.



The production quality of your introduction video is not being evaluated. We are evaluating your communication, professionalism, thought process, attention to instructions, and ability to represent a professional company.



PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS



Provide at least three examples of work that you personally created or managed.



Examples may include:



* Short-form videos

* Long-form YouTube content

* LinkedIn posts or profiles

* Social-media accounts

* Carousels or graphics

* Email campaigns

* Content calendars

* Performance reports

* AI-presenter videos



For each example, explain:



* What you personally created or managed

* Which tools you used

* The objective of the work

* Any measurable results available



Do not submit work created entirely by another person.



WRITTEN APPLICATION QUESTIONS



1. Which social-media platforms have you personally managed?



2. Describe your experience managing LinkedIn personal profiles or company pages.



3. Have you used LinkedIn Sales Navigator? If so, explain how you used it.



4. Which video-editing and AI-content tools have you used?



5. Describe how you would turn one five-minute educational video into content for YouTube, Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn, and email.



6. What steps do you complete before publishing a post, video, or email?



7. Describe your email-marketing experience and the platforms you have used.



8. What marketing metrics matter beyond views and followers?



9. How would you respond if someone asked a personalized tax or financial question in the comments or direct messages?



10. How do you organize scripts, source files, drafts, approvals, and published assets?



11. Are you comfortable performing routine work such as uploading, scheduling, file naming, caption formatting, checking links, and maintaining trackers?



12. Are you currently working for other clients? If so, describe your schedule and availability.



13. What monthly compensation are you seeking?



14. Please provide two professional references.



SELECTION PROCESS



Qualified applicants may be invited to:



* Attend a video interview

* Complete a short paid skills assessment

* Repurpose one fictional educational video into several content formats

* Edit a short AI-presenter clip

* Draft one LinkedIn post, one short-form caption, and one email

* Identify errors or compliance concerns in sample content

* Prepare a brief content-performance summary



We are looking for a dependable, creative, detail-oriented professional who wants to become a trusted and long-term member of VLARI.

title: Online Math & ELA Teacher (K–8) | PRC-Licensed | 8–14 Students | Early-Morning PH Schedule
description:
Teach the way you always wanted to: one student at a time, with real results.



Thrive Alliance is a U.S. tutoring company with one promise to every family: one full grade level of growth in 12 weeks. We're growing, and we're looking for a few more teachers to join a team that shows up, delivers, and celebrates student wins together.



You'll teach Kindergarten through Grade 8 Math and English one-on-one through MobyMax. The platform handles diagnostics, skill targets, and mastery checks, so there's no lesson planning from scratch. You bring the teaching, the patience, and the energy that makes a struggling student believe they can do it.



What you get



A full caseload of 8–14 students, each seeing you twice a week, so you build real relationships and watch them grow

Full training on MobyMax and our teaching system before your first session.



Structured curriculum, clear expectations, and an Operations Manager who handles all parent communication

A $400 bonus every time 90% or more of your students gain a full grade level in a 12-week cycle

A team that values reliability and rewards it.



Who thrives here!



You've taught real classes and loved it. You're ready to go today: your own laptop, headset, stable internet, and a quiet, clean background. You can stay warm, focused, and positive on camera for hours, and your sixth student gets the same energy as your first.



Most of all, you're someone who only needs to be asked once. When something needs doing, it's done: sessions on time, notes entered, reports in, no reminders needed. If that sounds like you, you'll fit right in.



Schedule

Weekday classes run Monday–Thursday, 3:00–9:00 PM US Central Time:



Now through Nov 1: 4:00–10:00 AM Philippine time, Tuesday–Friday

From Nov 1: 5:00–11:00 AM Philippine time, Tuesday–Friday



You choose your caseload:



8 students: 4 hours a day, 4 days a week



12 students: the full 6-hour window, 4 days a week



14 students: the full weekday window plus one weekend block of about 4 hours, scheduled with you during onboarding



Students are added during your first weeks until your caseload is full. Weekly student reports are due each Friday US time (Saturday PH time), and that reporting time is paid.



Pay



$4.00 USD per hour taught, plus up to 2.5 paid reporting hours per week

Sent by Wise on the 15th and 30th of every month

At full caseload: about $277/month (8 students), $416/month (12 students), or $485/month (14 students), plus up to about $43/month in reporting pay

$400 performance bonus on top



Requirements



Active PRC license (LET passer)

Experience teaching classes or tutoring K–8 students

Clear spoken and written English

Comfortable on live video (Google Meet) for up to 6 hours at a stretch

Your own equipment and reliable internet, ready now

Able to keep the same schedule every week



Our hiring process

Application review, a short interview, PRC license verification, a brief subject placement assessment, and a 15-minute mock lesson during our actual teaching hours.



How to apply

We read every application that follows these steps. Applications that skip any step are not reviewed. Following instructions carefully is the first thing we look for.



Start your message with the word Thrive.

Give your PRC license number.

Tell us which caseload you want (8, 12, or 14 students) and confirm you can teach those exact hours every week.

Share a link to a 60–90 second video introducing yourself and explaining one Math or English concept as you would to a 4th grader.

Attach a photo of your teaching setup and a speed test screenshot.



We can't wait to meet you.

title: Junior Organic Content Strategist + Editor | Social Media, YouTube & Video
description:
Hello, we're looking for a full-time Junior Organic Content Strategist + Editor to help grow a founder's personal brand through social media, YouTube, and video content.



This role combines content strategy, research, scripting, and hands-on video editing.



You'll help figure out what we should create, develop the idea and script, and turn recordings into finished long-form and short-form content.



You don't need to be an expert at everything. We're looking for someone motivated, curious, creative, and eager to become very good at both content strategy and editing.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Research topics, creators, competitors, trends, and content formats

• Find interesting content ideas, angles, and hooks

• Help develop YouTube topics, titles, outlines, and scripts

• Help write short-form scripts and hooks

• Edit long-form YouTube videos

• Edit Reels, Shorts, and other short-form content

• Find strong moments from long-form recordings to turn into clips

• Repurpose content across YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other platforms

• Help organize the content calendar

• Review content performance and identify patterns

• Suggest new content ideas based on what is working

• Help improve the organic content system over time



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Strong interest in social media, YouTube, and organic content

• Good writing and communication skills

• Strategic and creative thinking

• Good understanding of hooks, storytelling, and attention

• Basic to intermediate video editing skills

• Strong research skills

• Good eye for what makes content interesting

• Comfortable using AI tools

• Strong attention to detail

• Reliable and organized



Editing tools



Experience with one or more of these is a plus:

• CapCut

• DaVinci Resolve

• Premiere Pro

• Canva

• Figma



You don't need to know all of them. We're more interested in your ability to learn and create.



Bonus if you have experience with:

• YouTube

• Instagram / Reels

• TikTok / Shorts

• LinkedIn

• Scriptwriting

• Personal brands

• Content strategy



PERSONALITY MATTERS



We're looking for someone who is hungry to improve.



You should naturally notice good content and ask:

Why did this work?

Why did people keep watching?

What could we do differently?

How can we turn one piece of content into five more?



You don't need to have built a successful personal brand before.



We want someone who is proactive, coachable, curious, and genuinely excited about becoming very good at content.



Over time, we'd like you to become someone who can take an idea from:



Research → Idea → Hook → Script → Video → Repurposing → Distribution → Learning



SCHEDULE



Full-time, 40 hours/week

Monday to Friday

Remote

You'll work with an international team and join 3 team calls per week.



COMPENSATION

₱30,000/month (~$500 USD) starting salary



APPLICATION QUESTIONS

1. What social media platforms do you understand best?

2. What video editing software do you use and how experienced are you with it?

3. Have you created, scripted, or edited content before? Tell us briefly about it.

4. Please share examples of your work.

5. Pick one creator or personal brand you think does organic content extremely well. What do you think they're doing differently?



IMPORTANT



Start your application with the word Organic on the first line.



Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be reviewed.



TRIAL TASK



Shortlisted applicants may complete a small paid trial task involving content research, scripting, and video editing.



The task will help us evaluate your thinking, creativity, editing ability, attention to detail, and ability to follow a brief.



GROWTH PATH



As you grow, you'll take more ownership over content strategy, research, scripting, YouTube, editing, short-form content, repurposing, and organic growth.



We don't promise promotions or timelines. Growth depends on your performance, skills, and ability to take ownership.



If you're motivated to become genuinely great at content and want to help build a personal brand from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

title: E-commerce Recruiter
description:
Facelove Cosmetics is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer beauty brand built for women over 40, with a strong presence across the US and EU markets.



The Role



We're looking for a DTC E-commerce Recruiter to own end-to-end hiring for the roles that actually move revenue: paid media, creative strategy, retention, Shopify/CRO, and the creative talent behind our ads. You'll work directly with our HR Manager and founders to keep both contractor and full-time pipelines full of strong, vetted candidates.



This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a coordination-only role. You'll source proactively, run structured screens, and bring sharp judgment to who's actually a fit. In DTC, the gap between someone who ran an ad account and someone who sat next to one is enormous, and we need you to be able to tell the difference on a 30-minute call.



What You'll Do



Manage full-cycle recruitment across DTC e-commerce functions: paid media buying, growth, creative strategy, retention/email, Shopify and CRO, analytics, and e-commerce ops

Recruit high-volume creative contractor roles, including video editors and UGC-style creative talent, running trial-based assessment at scale

Write and refine job descriptions that attract the right candidates and filter out the wrong ones

Source proactively through LinkedIn Recruiter, OnlineJobs.ph, job boards, competitor mapping, and outbound

Screen resumes, portfolios, and ad-performance claims, run initial interviews, and produce structured, comparable candidate assessments for hiring managers

Coordinate interview scheduling across time zones with hiring managers and founders

Draft offers and manage the process through to signature

Maintain a clean, up-to-date pipeline in GoHire and LinkedIn Recruiter

Flag pipeline or spec issues early. If a role's requirements are producing no viable candidates, bring evidence and options rather than continuing to source blindly

Spot red flags before they reach final interviews: inflated spend figures, metrics that contradict each other, reused or scraped creative work, agency work presented as in-house, overlapping employment dates

What You'll Need



3+ years of recruitment experience with a track record hiring for DTC, e-commerce, or performance-marketing-driven companies

Recruitment agency or staffing firm background preferred. We want someone who has carried a req load and a placement target, not someone who has only supported an internal HR function

Working fluency in the DTC vocabulary: ROAS, CAC, MER, AOV, LTV, hook rate, creative testing. You don't need to be a marketer, but you can't be bluffed by one

Comfortable evaluating creative portfolios (video, static, UGC) alongside more traditional e-commerce and ops backgrounds

Strong sourcing skills. You don't post and pray

Excellent written communication. You can write both a sharp JD and a warm, human candidate email

Ability to work core hours aligned to CET

Comfortable working independently in a fully remote, fast-moving environment

Experience with hiring or ATS tools such as GoHire and LinkedIn Recruiter is a plus

How you work



- You move fast and d
 with incomplete information

- You'd rather be corrected than be wrong for a quarter

- You are comfortable telling a founder their favourite campaign isn't working

- You want ownership, not a brief



What we offer



- Real ownership of the most important function in the business, with a direct line to the founders

- Remote-first, async-friendly, results-measured

- A brand with genuine product-market fit and room to scale

title: Head of Paid Media
description:
Facelove is a fast-growing DTC beauty brand in the US. We're direct-response first, the large majority of our revenue comes from paid acquisition, and every decision we make is measured against CAC, MER and contribution margin.



We're scaling quickly, and we're looking for a Head of Paid Media to own that growth: someone who has run serious spend before, knows what breaks at scale, and can build the system that gets us to the next level.



About the Role: 



You'll take full ownership of paid acquisition across Meta, Google, TikTok and AppLovin, managing $3–5M in monthly spend.



This is a strategy and ownership role. You'll have a team of junior media buyers who handle the implementation, from building and launching campaigns, ad uploads, naming conventions, and day-to-day platform work. title: Full Stack Developer - Internal Tools
description:
About us



We make cosmetics for women over 45 and sell direct to consumer in the US and Germany. We're launching on Amazon in September. The company currently runs on Google Sheets, Slack threads and a few hand-built HTML tools, and that's no longer holding. We're building real internal systems and you'd be the person who builds them.



This isn't a Shopify or storefront role. Someone else owns the stores. You work entirely on internal systems.



What you'd work on



Rebuilding our supply chain tracker. Our supply chain manager built it herself with Claude. The logic is good but it saves to her browser, only she can edit it, and there's no record of who changed what. You'd turn it into a proper multi-user system with a Postgres backend, logins and roles, an audit trail, file storage against records, and automatic daily sales ingestion from Slack.

An internal tools platform. Our CEO builds tools with Claude (OKR tracker, comp planner) and they've got nowhere to live. You'd set up a private subdomain, one login across all of them, and data that persists.

Automations and integrations. Scheduled jobs syncing Slack and ClickUp, plus MCP servers so our AI agents can query internal data directly.



What you need



3+ years shipping full-stack web apps, with work we can look at

TypeScript, React or Next.js

Postgres, plus Supabase or Firebase including auth and row-level security

REST APIs and webhooks, with real experience of rate limits, retries and integrations that fail overnight

Deployment, DNS, environment and secret management

AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) as part of how you actually work

Written English strong enough to run async with a COO in another timezone



Nice to have

Slack API, ClickUp API, Python for data pipelines, Shopify Admin API, MCP servers, ecommerce or inventory experience. Also: taking over someone else's prototype and making it maintainable without making them feel bad about it.



We don't care about degrees, certifications or agency logos.



How we work

Flexible hours with meaningful overlap with Manila. Written end-of-day updates, work tracked in ClickUp. You'll get requirements from a COO, not a product manager. Some will be wrong and we expect you to say so. Every system ships with a README and a handover note.



This is ongoing, not a project. We'd rather grow it into full-time than hand it to someone else in six months.



How to apply: 



Send us:



- A link to something you built that non-technical people use daily, and a sentence on what broke and what you changed

- Your answer to this: our tracker currently saves everything to browser local storage. Outline how you'd move it to a database without losing historical data and without our supply chain manager losing a day of work during the switch. Six sentences is plenty.



Applications without the second item won't be read.

title: DTC E-commerce Customer Support Representative
description:
Zoyava is a leading digital-native brand rapidly expanding its market presence by delivering top-notch, user-friendly supplements on different platforms. Our dedication to unparalleled quality and exceptional customer experience drives our operations. We believe every employee's contribution is indispensable to our company's success.



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for a customer-first rep who genuinely enjoys helping people and knows how to stay calm, clear, and solutions-focused even when things get messy. You're comfortable navigating Shopify, handling subscription issues, and pushing back on chargebacks without breaking a sweat. You take ownership of every ticket, follow through until it's resolved, and treat every customer interaction as a chance to leave a good impression. If you thrive in a fast-moving DTC environment and care about getting things right, we want to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities



Customer Support

Respond to customer inquiries via email with speed, professionalism, and accuracy.

Handle a high volume of tickets while keeping quality and tone consistent.

Resolve complaints, shipping issues, product questions, and post-purchase concerns efficiently.

Shopify & Subscription Management

Ensure timely resolution of customer requests while maintaining a seamless experience throughout the customer journey.

Chargebacks & Disputes

Manage chargebacks and payment disputes end-to-end, including evidence collection and submission.

Monitor dispute trends and contribute to reducing chargeback rates through proactive problem-solving.

Work closely with internal teams to flag recurring issues that may be driving disputes.

Customer Retention

Identify opportunities to retain customers through effective issue resolution and subscription-saving strategies.

Recognize when a customer is on the fence and apply the right approach to keep them.

Regularly surface customer feedback and insights to help improve products, processes, and the overall customer experience.



Skills and Requirements



At least 1 to 2 years of customer service experience in a DTC, eCommerce, or subscription-based environment.

Hands-on experience with Shopify, including order management and basic account troubleshooting.

Familiarity with chargeback processes and payment dispute workflows (experience with Stripe, PayPal, or similar platforms is a plus).

Strong written English communication skills with a friendly, professional tone.

Detail-oriented with solid organizational habits and the ability to manage multiple open tickets at once.

Comfortable working independently in a fully remote setup with minimal supervision.

A genuine drive to resolve issues fully, not just close tickets.



Nice to Have



Experience with helpdesk tools such as Gorgias, Zendesk, or Freshdesk.

Prior work in health, wellness, or supplements eCommerce.

Exposure to subscription retention strategies or save flows.



What We Offer:



A dynamic and supportive work environment in a fast-growing company.

Attractive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

Opportunities for professional growth and development.

HMO

The ideal instructor should have proven real-world trading experience as well as strong academic/theoretical knowledge of financial markets, technical analysis, fundamental analysis, risk management, and trading psychology.

- Market fundamentals and how the market works (Forex, Crypto, Options and Futures)

title: Executive Support Specialist
description:
Executive Support Specialist

US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



The client moves fast. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — before anyone notices it almost did.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to answer
s and schedule meetings. You’re here to make sure the clients you support never have to think twice about whether something is handled.



We’re looking for an Executive Support Specialist who operates like a second brain — someone who anticipates needs before they’re voiced, manages complexity without being asked, and treats the client’s time as the most valuable resource in the business.



You’ll own administrative operations, client communication, and organizational systems across a fast-moving environment. You’ll also be expected to use AI tools actively — not occasionally — to work faster, produce better outputs, and eliminate manual work that shouldn’t exist in the first place.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best Executive Support Specialists we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They’re the person their friends call when they need to figure something out. Not because they always have the answer — but because they know how to think through a problem, ask the right questions, and get to a solution

They don’t wait to be told. If they see something that needs to happen, they handle it — then let the client know it’s done, not ask if they should do it

They’re honest even when it costs them. If they make a mistake, they say so immediately. If something isn’t working, they raise it. They don’t manage perception — they manage reality

They’re genuinely curious. It’s not enough to be smart — they actively seek out new things to learn, ask questions other people don’t think to ask, and find most topics at least a little interesting

They treat confidentiality as non-negotiable. What happens in the client’s world stays there — no exceptions, no grey areas

They use AI the way a sharp operator would — not as a novelty, but as a tool that makes their output faster and better than anyone who isn’t using it



Who Thrives Here



People who are quietly excellent — not flashy, but consistently sharp, reliable, and ahead of the curve. You don’t need recognition for every task you handle. You find satisfaction in the fact that things run smoothly because of you, even if no one notices the work behind it.



We’re a growing MSP, which means priorities shift, new tasks appear, and not everything is perfectly documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a problem — it’s an environment where someone who takes initiative and uses every tool available naturally stands out.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a client’s world that has real moving parts — relationships, internal deadlines, communication threads, administrative backlogs, and calendar complexity. Your job is to bring order, anticipate what’s next, and make sure the client is always walking into rooms prepared — and to use AI tools to do all of it faster and better than it’s been done before.



That looks like:



Managing the client’s calendar end-to-end — scheduling, rescheduling, prioritizing conflicts, and making sure every meeting has a purpose and a brief before it happens

Handling inbound communication across
, phone, and messaging platforms — triaging, responding where appropriate, and escalating only what genuinely needs the client’s attention

Using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) to draft communications, summarize threads, generate reports, and prepare briefing materials faster than manual methods allow

Tracking open action items, follow-ups, and deadlines so nothing slips — and surfacing anything at risk before it becomes a problem

Preparing reports, presentations, meeting agendas, and briefing materials that are clear, accurate, and ready to use without further editing

Identifying repetitive administrative tasks and using AI-powered workflows or automation tools to eliminate them — not just complete them faster

Managing inquiries and interactions with professionalism and warmth — resolving what can be resolved, escalating what can’t, and always following through

Maintaining organized, accurate records across CRM systems, shared drives, and administrative databases — so information is findable, current, and reliable

Coordinating meetings, travel, and logistics across time zones with the kind of detail orientation that means surprises don’t happen

Supporting social media scheduling, market research, and competitor analysis when needed — using AI tools to accelerate research and content production



What We’re Looking For



Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, and easy to listen to. A strong accent is completely fine; what matters is that clients never have to work hard to understand you and walk away from every interaction feeling heard

Proven experience in an executive support, virtual assistant, or administrative role — you know what it takes to support a high-output client and you’ve done it before

Active, confident use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or equivalent) — you use them daily to produce better work faster, not as a novelty you tried once

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace — you don’t need training on the basics, you need a challenge

Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or equivalent) — you can maintain records, track interactions, and generate reports without hand-holding

Strong written English communication — your
s are clear, professional, and require no revisions before they’re sent

Experience with social media management and scheduling tools — you can plan, post, and monitor across platforms without supervision

High accuracy and attention to detail — you catch errors before they leave your desk, not after

Strong organizational and time-management skills — you manage multiple priorities simultaneously and nothing slips through

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask the right questions early to get there

Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities — in a fast-moving environment, plans change; you adapt without losing momentum

Long-term mindset — you want to build trust over time, not treat this as a stepping stone



Nice to Have



Experience with AI-powered workflow automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n, or equivalent)

Experience supporting C-suite or senior leadership in a remote environment

Familiarity with project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello, or 
)

Basic bookkeeping (QuickBooks or Xero)

Experience with market research and competitor analysis



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new team members.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand how our clients operate, our tools, our standards, and how information flows across the business. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape how they support clients and manage their work.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



The client’s calendar is clean, communication is handled, and nothing is falling through the cracks

You’re already using AI tools to produce outputs faster than expected

Your systems are making things more organized than they were before you arrived



At 6 months:



You’re anticipating needs before they’re voiced

The client spends less time on administration and more time on what only they can do

You’ve identified repetitive tasks and automated or streamlined them using AI tools — without being asked



At 12 months:



You’re an indispensable part of how the business operates

The client trusts your judgment completely

You’ve built AI-powered systems and habits that would be immediately felt if they disappeared


 is investing in your continued growth



How We Work



You won’t be micromanaged. We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.



There’s real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the workflows, systems, and habits that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You need constant direction and check-ins to stay on track

You treat “that’s not my job” as a reasonable response

You let things slip and wait for someone else to notice

You’d stay quiet about a mistake to avoid a difficult conversation

Confidentiality feels like a guideline rather than a hard rule

You’re uncomfortable with shifting priorities and changing plans

You’ve never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don’t intend to start

Learning new things feels like a chore rather than something you actually enjoy



There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth opportunities in a fast-moving, systems-focused environment

description:
SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR (RETENTION-FOCUSED)

Health & Wellness Brand | Part-Time → Long-Term | Remote



ABOUT US

We're a US health and wellness brand building one of the biggest short-form accounts in hormones, weight loss, and longevity. Our founder films 10+ talking-head reels a week. We need an editor who makes them impossible to scroll past, not just someone who cuts them.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit about 10 talking-head reels per week (30–60 seconds) from raw footage and a short brief

- Restructure when needed: move the strongest line to the start, cut dead air hard, reorder the talk if it flows better

- Build retention: a visual change every 2–3 seconds (zooms, B-roll, graphics), an on-screen text hook, and clean designed captions

- Cut 4 hook variants per week: new openings on our past reels, and tell us which ones you'd try

- Send 1–2 honest notes with every batch (for example "take 2 was stronger, here's why" or "this story is too long for 40 seconds")

- Review our weekly performance numbers from our analyst and adjust your edits based on what's working

- Deliver on time, with subtitle files (.srt) and clean file naming in Google Drive



TURNAROUND

Within 48 hours of receiving footage.



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years editing short-form video (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)

- Premiere Pro, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve

- Portfolio with view counts or retention results

- English strong enough to follow spoken content and give clear notes

- Bonus: talking-head, podcast-clip, or health/fitness content experience



IMPORTANT

We're a health brand, so all on-screen text and captions are approved by us before posting. Never add claims, stats, or text that isn't in the brief.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Write "RETENTION" as the first word of your application.

2. Send 3 short-form videos you edited, with their views or retention.

3. Pick one of them and tell us what you changed and why.

4. Watch this reel of ours: [link]. Tell us the first thing you'd fix.

Applications without all four will not be reviewed.

title: SOCIAL MEDIA RESEARCH & PERFORMANCE ANALYST
description:
SOCIAL MEDIA RESEARCH & PERFORMANCE ANALYST

Health & Wellness Short-Form Video | Part-Time (20–25 hrs/week) | Remote | Long-Term



ABOUT US

We're a US health and wellness brand building one of the biggest short-form video accounts in hormones, weight loss, and longevity. We need a detail-obsessed analyst who finds what's working in our space every week, tracks every number on our own account, and tells us what to change next.



This is a research and analytics role, not a content-creation role. If you love spreadsheets, spotting patterns, and figuring out why something went viral, keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL DO EVERY WEEK



1. Outlier Report

Monitor about 40 accounts we give you, plus new ones you find. Find the 20 best-performing reels of the week, ranked by outlier score (a reel's views divided by that account's typical views), not raw views. Log each one in our Google Sheet: link, account, followers, views, likes, comments, shares (if visible), length, and format.



2. Hooks & Transcripts

For the top 10, write down word for word the first sentence spoken and the on-screen text in the first 3 seconds. Then transcribe the full reel.



3. Swipe File

Save the top 10 reels into our Google Drive library, tagged by hook type and format. This is for internal reference only and is never reposted.



4. Comment Mining

Collect 20 real questions people are asking in the comments of top reels, copied word for word with the link.



5. Trend Scan

List any topic that 3 or more accounts posted about this week.



6. Competitor Ads

Check the Meta Ad Library for the brands we list. Record any ad that has been running for more than 30 days, with screenshots.



7. Performance Tracking & Weekly Optimization

Own our content tracker. Log every reel we post: topic, hook, format, and length. Update its stats at 24 hours, 7 days, and 30 days: views, average watch time, skip rate, 3-second hold, shares, saves, follows, and non-follower reach. Run a weekly test log, where we change one thing at a time.



Every Sunday, deliver a one-page memo:

- Our top 3 and bottom 3 reels, and what the winners have in common

- Which hook type won this week, and the trend over the last 4 weeks

- How our numbers compare with the top reels in our space

- 4 past reels worth re-posting with a new opening

- The ONE change you'd test next week

- Anything unusual (spikes, drops, a reel suddenly getting shared)



8. Cross-Posting

Post every approved reel to TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and
, and track the stats on each platform.



9. Content Ops

Organize video and subtitle files from our editor in Google Drive, and schedule approved posts in Meta Business Suite.



YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS

- Week 1: Enter every reel we've already posted into the tracker so we have a baseline.

- Weeks 1–4: Write a short SOP (a doc or Loom video) for every recurring task you do.



HOW WE WORK

- Weekly report and memo due every Monday, 8:00 AM Manila time

- A short daily update in Slack: what you did, what's next, and anything blocking you

- One 20-minute call each week: [Monday 9:00 AM Manila time]

- 20–25 hours per week, flexible outside the call



HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED

- The Monday report arrives on time every week

- Transcripts are word-for-word accurate

- Stories from your report make it onto our content slate

- Your recommended tests actually get run and move our numbers



REQUIREMENTS

- Strong written English, especially accurate transcription

- Very comfortable with Google Sheets (formulas, sorting, clean formatting)

- Uses Instagram and TikTok daily and understands Reels metrics

- Reliable internet and on-time delivery every single week

- Bonus: experience with social analytics or scraping tools (Apify, Social Blade, etc.) or the health/fitness space



PAY & GROWTH

[$X/month], paid via [method]. Paid trial week first. Pay review at 90 days, with room to grow into running our social analytics.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Write "OUTLIER" as the first word of your application.

2. Pick any creator in health or fitness. Compare two of their recent reels, one that did well and one that didn't, and explain in 5–6 sentences what you think made the difference.

Applications without both will not be reviewed.

title: Consultative Closer (Phone-Based) - Admissions and Enrollment Advisor
description:
ABOUT US:

Access Computer Training is a Florida-based, CIE-licensed technical training school with 12+ years in operation and 700+ graduates who have launched careers in IT, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Office Admin, and Project Management. Most of our students train through workforce grant funding, Vocational Rehabilitation, or VA benefits — so they don't pay out of pocket. Students who don't qualify for funding can self-pay in full or finance their training through Fortify, so there's a path for nearly every applicant we talk to.





JOB SUMMARY:

We're hiring a CLOSER — an Admissions and Enrollment Advisor. NOT a coordinator. NOT a customer service rep. NOT an outbound cold salesperson.



We're hiring a career coach who can advise and enroll students, and who can pivot the conversation on a moment's notice. Your focus is to relate to each applicant's work history and background — using AI heavily to do this — and guide them toward the program that genuinely fits them, with real clarity on what their journey looks like post-graduation: certify, land a great job in their new professional role, earn a higher salary, and build a better work/life balance — and how we help them get there.



You'll have access to information the applicant already filled out before the call, so you'll know going in whether they qualify for a tech training grant, or whether you'll need to pivot the conversation to self-pay — which is a much harder conversation to persuade someone into investing in themselves.



We provide all the training and tools to help you succeed in this. This is a sales role with a script foundation, NOT a scripted read-and-recite job — we need someone who can hear resistance and work it, not just push through a call flow.





WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO:

> Outbound and inbound calls to warm leads (not cold prospecting — these people already inquired)

> Qualify leads against 4 funding paths in the first 5 minutes of a call

> Run consultation calls and close on a signed enrollment agreement

> Handle real objections — cost, timing, "I need to think about it," "I already talked to someone else" — without going off-script into guesses

> Re-engage leads who've gone stagnant for weeks or months, not just work fresh warm leads — a real part of the job is getting people who fell through the cracks back into the pipeline

> Log every call and follow-up in our CRM (GoHighLevel) same-day — no exceptions

 



HOW WE ACTUALLY RUN A CALL:

We're not a hard-sell operation. Every real ACT call starts the same way: find out where this person actually is — their current skills, education, work history — and where they genuinely want to go, before naming a single program. Funding options get matched to their situation, not pitched as a one-size script.

 

You have to actually LISTEN to the answer before d
 where the call goes next — not plan your next line while they're still talking. This is the single biggest thing that separates a real closer from someone just running through a script.

 

You'll still need to close — get to a signed enrollment agreement, handle real objections, keep a deal from going cold — but the close has to sit on top of real listening, not replace it.

 

Funding qualification sometimes touches sensitive personal or financial territory (household income, marital or partner status) — ask with tact and let the context guide you, never lead with it.

 

If your instinct is to pitch first and ask questions later, this isn't the right role, no matter how good you are at closing.

 



TOOLS AND SETUP YOU'LL NEED:

Dual monitors (or the ability to run one) — you'll be using AI tools (ChatGPT/Claude) LIVE, on the call, to quickly research a lead's background or an unfamiliar job/certification and generate relevant talking points in real time. This is a real, expected part of how we work, not an occasional shortcut.





YOU'RE A STRONG FIT IF:

> You lead with genuine curiosity about a stranger's situation before you pitch anything — and you can still close once you understand what they actually need

> You have real phone-sales closing experience — outbound sales, telemarketing, insurance sales (not claims/service), timeshare, solar, BPO sales campaigns, or similar

> You're comfortable being told "no" multiple times a day and staying warm anyway

> Your spoken English is clear and confident on a live call, not just written English

> You've worked with a CRM before and you update it without being chased

> You're willing to study outside paid hours, especially in the first weeks — learning our programs, funding sources, and county-by-county grant rules takes real ramp-up time, and that self-driven learning is what separates people who succeed here from people who don't

> You can handle emotionally heavy calls with composure — many leads are in genuine financial or personal crisis — while still being able to tell, over time, who's motivated and who isn't, without burning yourself out trying to save everyone

> You can stay with a lead through a long process — sometimes coaching or helping them advocate for themselves with a funding agency over weeks or months, not just qualifying and closing once

> You can commit to a graveyard shift — this is a US Eastern-time role

 



THIS IS NOT A FIT IF:

// Your background is customer service, data entry, chat support, or general VA work with no sales/closing component

// You've done appointment-setting but have never actually closed the deal yourself

// You're looking for a quiet admin role — this is a talk-to-strangers-on-the-phone-all-day role

 



TO APPLY — THIS STEP IS REQUIRED, NOT OPTIONAL:

> Send a 60-second voice recording (phone memo is fine) responding to this exact objection, as if you were on a live call: 



"I already talked to another school and I'm not sure yours is any different." 



> We're listening for how you actually sound on a call, not for a perfect script.

> Include a link to your resume.



**APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VOICE RECORDING WILL NOT BE PROCESSED.

 



HOURS: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST (this is a 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippines time shift)
